chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, who said:
I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about the two rakʿahs of dawn, and he said: Insert them within the salat of the night.

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the Imam being asked for the ruling
key_terms.اللَّيْلِ: the night; here referring to salat al-layl
key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: dawn; here referring to the two rakʿahs associated with fajr
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ: the two units of prayer under discussion

ai.seo_question: How should the two rakʿahs of fajr be performed in relation to salat al-layl?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling concerning the two rakʿahs of fajr and their placement in relation to salat al-layl. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام instructs that they are to be joined into the night prayer sequence, indicating their devotional and legal connection to it.
